top.title: AI reportedly solves a major open math problem, prompting debate
top.summary: IEEE Spectrum reports that AI solved a major unsolved math problem, a claim prompting debate among mathematicians. The excerpt does not identify the problem or provide details of the proposed proof.
top.why: Treat this as a research milestone to watch, not yet as evidence that hosted models can reliably handle formal mathematical reasoning.

also.title: OpenAI adds visual ads and expanded ad measurement to ChatGPT
also.summary: OpenAI introduced a visual ad format in ChatGPT and expanded measurement, attribution partnerships, and brand-suitability tools for advertisers.
